title: record discussion feed: thirteen consecutive system entries "Updated Campaign \"CPG-0001 - …\"" with no field diff — an update event should carry what changed and consecutive same-actor updates should fold
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's (the event producer is the platform's audit / activity path; the renderer is objectui's — triage decides which side carries the diff).

## What is seen (HotCRM on 18.1.0, demo seed)

Campaign CPG-0001 → 讨论 (13): thirteen entries, all 「系统 · 8分钟前 · Updated Campaign "CPG-0001 - Q3 Enterprise Email Nurture"」, one after another, no field named. They come from the seed's member-enrollment rollups (`target_count`, `sent_count`, `response_count`, … bumped once per member). A reader cannot tell what changed, and the thirteen rows push any human comment off the screen. [56-campaign-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/56-campaign-tall.png). Compare the owner-change entries on an account, which do say 「Account Owner: ∅ → Dev Admin」 — the feed can show a diff; the generic update does not.

`reach:` the public UI, measured once; any record that a flow or rollup updates repeatedly (campaigns, opportunities under approval, cases under SLA monitoring) shows the same wall.

## Expected

- An update entry names the changed fields and old → new values (as the owner-change entry already does), or at least the field names.
- Consecutive updates by the same actor within a short window fold into one entry with a count (「系统更新了 5 个字段 · 13 次」).
- Seed and system writes are still recorded; the folding is a rendering choice over the same events.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectstack "record discussion feed shows many identical Updated entries from the seed with no field change detail" → 6 hits (#24562, #24624, #21646, #12923, #3932, #3434), all about seed replay rewriting rows, not about the feed's rendering of updates. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §3.7.
